tasks.label: PN51 Cluster Status
tasks.command: kubectl --kubeconfig .local/kubeconfig get nodes -o wide && kubectl --kubeconfig .local/kubeconfig get pods,pvc -A

tasks.label: PN51 Platform Reconcile
tasks.command: make platform-check && make configure ANSIBLE='.venv/bin/ansible-playbook --start-at-task "Validate the domain and vaulted identity secrets"'

tasks.label: PN51 Platform Recovery
tasks.command: make platform-check && make configure ANSIBLE='.venv/bin/ansible-playbook --start-at-task "Validate the domain and vaulted identity secrets"'

tasks.label: PN51 Worker Recovery
tasks.command: make replace-worker NODE=pn51-worker-2 CONFIRM_REPLACEMENT='replace pn51-worker-2' && make trust-guest-keys && make configure && make verify

tasks.label: PN51 Homepage and Argo CD
tasks.command: make configure ANSIBLE='.venv/bin/ansible-playbook --start-at-task "Create the isolated Argo CD and application namespaces"' && make verify

tasks.label: Fitness Deployment Prerequisites
tasks.command: export GIT_PAGER=cat GH_PAGER=cat; git --no-pager status --short && git -C ../fitness-tracker --no-pager status --short -- . ':!data' ':!logs' ':!stats' && git -C ../fitness-tracker rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse HEAD && for executable in gh docker podman buildah; do command -v "$executable" || true; done && gh api user --jq .login

tasks.label: Fitness Tracker Publishing Status
tasks.command: GH_PROMPT_DISABLED=1 GH_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat gh api repos/TheNewThinkTank/fitness-tracker --jq '{default_branch,visibility}' && GH_PROMPT_DISABLED=1 GH_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat gh api 'repos/TheNewThinkTank/fitness-tracker/actions/runs?branch=main&per_page=3' --jq '.workflow_runs[] | {status,conclusion,event,head_sha}'

tasks.label: Fitness Tracker Public Source Scan
tasks.command: for candidate in .github/workflows/job_docker_image.yml .github/workflows/wf.yml README.md src/utils/config.py test/utils/test_config.py test/utils/test_state_store.py; do cat -- "../fitness-tracker/$candidate"; printf '\n'; done | gitleaks stdin --redact --no-banner

tasks.label: Personal GitHub Login
tasks.command: source "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/dotfiles/personal-gh-path.sh" && gh auth login --hostname github.com --web --git-protocol https && gh api --hostname github.com user --jq .login

tasks.label: Fitness Tracker Release CI
tasks.command: source "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/dotfiles/personal-gh-path.sh" && GH_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat gh run watch 41817864050 --repo TheNewThinkTank/fitness-tracker --exit-status

tasks.label: Fitness Tracker Argo Acceptance
tasks.command: kubectl --kubeconfig .local/kubeconfig -n argocd wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.sync.status}'=Synced application/fitness-tracker-argo-application --timeout=300s && kubectl --kubeconfig .local/kubeconfig -n argocd wait --for=jsonpath='{.status.health.status}'=Healthy application/fitness-tracker-argo-application --timeout=300s && kubectl --kubeconfig .local/kubeconfig -n fitness-tracker get deployment,pod,pvc,ingress
